Computer.name: Avcon Credits Server
Computer.file:
Apparently the hacker group "Entropy" are looking for members - they're got a recruitment server up and everything.
You can connect to the server at "199.59.149.230"
-M

To overload a proxy, first set up some shell nodes on nodes you have administrator acess on. To do this, simply run the "shell" program (I.e: "exe shell").
Once you have several shells running, using their overload function while connected to a target machine will begin flooding the target with requests, overloading it until the proxy shuts down temporarily to catch up.
This will create a sizeable window in which programs that a proxy would otherwise prevent running can execute freely. -M
